items.title: Wycliffe Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: Wycliffe has performed with an impressive array of jazz artists to date, including Al Grey, Lionel Hampton, Shirley Horn and Wynton Marsalis.

ctx.x: Wycliffe Gordon was born in 1967 in Waynesboro, Georgia. He grew up in a musical household and took up the trombone at age twelve. Wycliffe has performed with an impressive array of jazz artists to date, including Al Grey, Lionel Hampton, Shirley Horn and Wynton Marsalis. His most recent composing effort is the score for the silent film “Body and Soul.”
Wycliffe was interviewed in Clearwater Beach, Florida on March 17, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
